box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #111827;

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Pretendard, 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', sans-serif; color: light-dark(#111827, #d4dae7); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
